description: Find companies in Europe and the Americas (US, CA, BR, MX) with fresh buying signals: started hiring in a function (e.g. first SDRs), hiring spikes, leadership roles, funding, acquisitions, product launches, expansions, partnerships, milestones, layoffs, revenue jumps, turning profitable, director changes and news. Data comes from company careers pages, ATS job boards, news feeds and public business registers, deepest in Slovakia, Czechia, Poland, Hungary, Austria and Germany. Filters combine with AND; values inside one filter with OR. Use employee_bands, business_models, HQ and office filters for company fit; job_countries, job_city, job_skill and min_new_roles to target openings; contract_buyer and contract_min_eur for SK/CZ public contracts. Use signal_rules for All, Any and Exclude with a window per rule. Returns ranked companies with dated evidence. Company facts only, no people.

contract_buyer.description: Buyer name contains this text on a qualifying SK/CZ signed public contract.

contract_min_eur.description: Minimum value of a qualifying SK/CZ signed public contract in EUR (CZK converted at a fixed reference rate).

countries.description: ISO-2 country codes of the company (SK Slovakia, CZ Czechia, PL Poland, HU Hungary, AT Austria, SI Slovenia, DE Germany, CH Switzerland, HR Croatia, RO Romania, GB United Kingdom, IE Ireland, FR France, BE Belgium, NL Netherlands, LU Luxembourg, ES Spain, PT Portugal, IT Italy, MT Malta, GR Greece, CY Cyprus, DK Denmark, SE Sweden, NO Norway, FI Finland, IS Iceland, EE Estonia, LV Latvia, LT Lithuania, BG Bulgaria, RS Serbia, BA Bosnia and Herzegovina, ME Montenegro, MK North Macedonia, AL Albania, UA Ukraine, MD Moldova, LI Liechtenstein, MC Monaco, AD Andorra, SM San Marino, US United States, CA Canada, BR Brazil, MX Mexico).

employee_bands.description: Employee bands. Use unknown to include companies without an employee band.

exclude_volume.description: Leave out volume hirers (staffing agencies, branch and field-sales networks, brokers, fundraisers). Set false to include them; they carry volume_hiring: true.

families.description: Hiring for these job functions. With only event kinds (e.g. funding) the company must also have an open role in one of these functions.

founded_from.description: Founded in this year or later.

founded_to.description: Founded in this year or earlier.

grant_min_eur.description: Minimum company-level net EU contribution in a signed Horizon Europe grant agreement. Pilot coverage is Slovakia and Czechia.

grant_topic.description: Text in a signed Horizon Europe project title, topic codes or keywords. Pilot coverage is Slovakia and Czechia.

job_city.description: Exact city of a qualifying new open role.

job_countries.description: Countries of qualifying new open roles. ISO-2.

job_skill.description: Exact skill normalized from a qualifying new open role.

kinds.description: Signal kinds that qualify a company (default: all). hiring = new roles in the window; first_in_function = first role in that function since we began tracking the company (at least 14 days earlier; job history starts 2026-10-16); hiring_spike = 3+ new roles in one function; leadership_role_open = head/director/VP/C-level role opened; revenue_jump and profitability_flip come from registry filings; funding, acquisition, launch, expansion, partnership, milestone and layoffs are moves read from the news; contract_won = signed a public-sector contract as supplier (SK/CZ registers, ≥ €10k); content_push = started or restarted publishing; tender_won = linked public award notice (EU TED, UK Find a Tender, Polish BZP); technology_detected = new website technology observed; new_country = first observed role outside HQ country; grant_signed = signed Horizon Europe grant agreement for a linked Slovak or Czech business.

min_new_roles.description: Minimum new open roles within the main window and matching all job filters.

min_open_jobs.description: Minimum current open jobs across the company.

office_countries.description: Countries with a known office, including headquarters. ISO-2.

offset.description: Skip this many companies (use `next` from the previous answer).

preview.description: Show the interpreted filters before running the search. Uses no search quota.

profitability.description: Profitability based on the latest filings available.

q.description: Company name, website or one-liner contains this text.

signal_rules.description: Up to four signal rules in mode:kind:days format, e.g. all:funding:90, any:expansion:30, exclude:layoffs:90. All rules are required, Any rules form one OR group, and Exclude rules reject matching companies. The days must be 7, 30 or 90.

since.description: Only signals newer than this ISO date or timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01.

sort.description: Rank by signal strength (default) or latest matching signal.

subs.description: Sub-roles within the chosen families, e.g. sales → sdr_bdr. By family: engineering: backend, frontend, fullstack, mobile, devops_sre, qa, embedded, security, architect, engineering_management; data: data_engineering, data_science, ml_ai, analytics_bi; product: product_management, product_owner, project_management; design: product_design, ux_research, graphic_brand; robotics: robot_programming, plc_controls, mechatronics, robotics_software; manufacturing: cnc_machining, production, maintenance, quality, process_engineering, mechanical_design, welding_fabrication; sales: account_executive, sdr_bdr, sales_management, partnerships, presales_solutions; marketing: growth, content, performance, product_marketing, brand_pr, marketing_management; customer: customer_success, support, account_management, implementation; operations: operations, supply_chain_logistics, office_admin, business_ops; finance: accounting, fp_and_a, controlling; people: recruiting, hr, people_ops; legal: legal, compliance; executive: c_level, general_management; other: .

tech.description: Exact name of a detected website technology.

tech_change.description: Exact technology name or ID newly observed on a website. Requires a dated technology observation.

tender_cpv.description: CPV category prefix (2 to 8 digits) of a linked public award notice (EU TED or UK Find a Tender).

name: search_signals
title: Search company signals
